title: One Announcement, many Deliveries; guidelines and lifecycle the same in pod and cloud
description:
**Design:** ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md (2026-11-16, Ryan). One Announcement (the decision, no channel) with one Delivery per channel (words, image, account, attempts, result address). Retries are attempts; corrections are new Deliveries that supersede the old one. Three cloud models (X announcement rows, newsletter ISSUE#/ROUNDUP# rows, ALERT# de-dup rows) plus the notifications story.published event become Announcement plus Delivery; the per-reader send ledger and transport stay in Caducus. Guidelines become GUIDELINE.md folders (cloud schema version 2). Lifecycle keys (stage, rating, review stamps) share names in a pod and in the cloud.

**Decisions accepted by Ryan, 2026-11-16:** (1) Announcement and Delivery are two records. (2) Guidelines become files with cloud schema version 2, converted once per site, no dual reader. (3) Pod review stamps are unverified claims; no stronger pod (no signature checks, no pod checklist, no local review ledger). Also standing: X feed stays OFF until the reshape lands and Ryan turns it on; no live X rows exist so nothing migrates there; a pod with no site is private and a load never publishes; a pod never grants five stars; a pod delivers in manual mode only.

**Related, not duplicated:** PPY-09ee86 (X announcements; this epic reshapes its model before go-live), PPY-824c14 (Caducus move; slices 6 and 7 follow it), PPY-2a2a8a (guidelines as data; slices 9 and 10 change what it built). The local-pod epic (profile, pod check, pod load) is not on this board yet (only the newsroom-pods initiative 2844a5 is); slices 11-13 depend on it when filed.

**Done when:** every slice is closed, the three old models are gone, and the p.apyr.us page is published. No real email addresses in any spec or fixture.

**Always-on agent standard (2026-11-16; design `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md`)**
This epic is now one client of the always-on agent standard (initiative PPY-a3fceb), not the standard itself. The announce and newsletter work runs as agents on the standard's wake queue, timers, ladder and outcomes.

**Names.** The decision record's model is `AnnouncementDecision`, because a model named `Announcement` (the old X row shape) is deployed and is deleted by PPY-efd06c. People and documents say "Announcement". Do not rename the model later: a rename is a new table and a data move for no gain.

**Revised order.**
1. Now, no dependency on the standard: guideline files in the cloud (PPY-1d5c43); the pod track (PPY-e4fd0c, PPY-50a7f5, PPY-8195a4); records (PPY-3792dd, built in PR #1618).
2. After the outcome vocabulary (PPY-f58445): the attempt log (PPY-a570e8).
3. After the wake queue (PPY-567bf9) and the Item change feed (PPY-8a374e): durable triggers (PPY-e3bb2b).
4. After the policy document (PPY-51ea61) and the gate (PPY-611397): the review policy (PPY-97c0f2), built as the announce responsibility's rung. Then, after follow-up timers (PPY-3ff011): the editing window (PPY-e8ec54). Then X on the new records (PPY-efd06c, X stays off), corrections (PPY-3e0a8a), manual mode (PPY-4410fc), channel guidelines (PPY-9c6b89), the drawer and list (PPY-e4ae3a).
5. After the Caducus move (PPY-824c14), the schedule trigger (PPY-2a53cd) and list cadence (PPY-4d74d9): email alerts (PPY-58d962), roundup issues (PPY-1e75aa), assembly (PPY-cb3cc9).
6. Last: the p.apyr.us page (PPY-e7eaa3), after the five walkthrough specs (PPY-00817a).

**Sibling epics under the same initiative:** newsletters and subscriptions (PPY-79c915) for weekly, daily and every-item lists; learning from edits (PPY-f51641).

**Design copies in the repository:** `docs/design/announcement-delivery-design.md` and `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (sections 15 to 18).
